title: Spectrum Shift
description: At the start of your turn, add [blue]1[/blue] random Colorless card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
smart_description: At the start of your turn, add [blue](stacks)[/blue] random Colorless cards into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
notes: Counter stacks indicate how many random Colorless cards are generated. Triggers at the start of each turn during hand draw phase.
